start: Stand facing a wall, feet together, about arm's length away
Palms on the wall at shoulder height, arms straight
Body straight from heels to head
end: Bend the elbows until the forehead nearly touches the wall
Keep hips in line, heels down
Press back to straight arms
PSH-01.altStart: Wall push-up, start position: standing about arm's length from a wall, leaning slightly forward with straight arms and palms on the wall at shoulder height.
PSH-01.altEnd: Wall push-up, end position: elbows bent and body leaning toward the wall until the face is close to it, body still straight and heels down.

start: Hands on a hip-high surface, shoulder-width
Walk the feet back until the body is straight
end: Lower until the chest touches the edge
Body stays rigid, elbows track back
Press back up to straight arms
PSH-02.altStart: Incline push-up, start position: body straight and inclined, hands on a hip-high surface with straight arms, balls of the feet on the floor.
PSH-02.altEnd: Incline push-up, end position: chest lowered to the edge of the surface with elbows bent, body still in a straight line.

start: Knees on the floor, hands under the shoulders
Straight line from knees through hips to head
end: Lower until the chest is a fist from the floor
Don't let the hips sag or pike
Press back to locked arms
PSH-03.altStart: Kneeling push-up, start position: kneeling with hands on the floor under the shoulders, arms straight and body straight from knees to head.
PSH-03.altEnd: Kneeling push-up, end position: chest lowered close to the floor with elbows bent, knees still down and hips in line.

start: Full push-up position, arms straight, body rigid
A basketball sits under the hips
end: Lower until the hips just touch the ball
That is about halfway: elbows near 90°
Press back up
PSH-04.altStart: Half push-up, start position: straight-arm push-up position on hands and toes with a basketball on the floor under the hips.
PSH-04.altEnd: Half push-up, end position: lowered halfway with elbows bent about 90 degrees until the hips touch the basketball.

start: Body straight from heels to head, toes tucked
end: Lower until the chest is a fist from the floor
Elbows go back, not flared wide
Press up to locked arms
PSH-05.altStart: Full push-up, start position: straight-arm push-up position on hands and toes, body in a straight line.
PSH-05.altEnd: Full push-up, end position: chest lowered to about a fist above the floor, elbows bent back along the body, body still straight.

end: Lower until the chest touches the backs of the hands
Elbows stay close to the ribs
Press back up
PSH-06.altStart: Close push-up, start position: push-up position with arms straight and the hands touching under the chest.
PSH-06.altEnd: Close push-up, end position: chest lowered to the hands with elbows bent close to the sides, body straight.

start: One hand on the floor, the other on a basketball
Ball hand about level with the shoulder
end: Lower until the chest is near the floor hand
Most of the work goes through the floor arm
Press up; swap sides each set
PSH-07.altStart: Uneven push-up, start position: push-up position with one hand on the floor and the other on a basketball, arms straight and body straight.
PSH-07.altEnd: Uneven push-up, end position: chest lowered toward the floor hand with both elbows bent, the other hand still on the basketball.

start: One hand under the outer chest, arm straight
Free hand on the small of the back, feet together
end: Lower on one arm until the hips touch the ball
Don't twist; keep the hips square
Press back up; swap arms
PSH-08.altStart: Half one-arm push-up, start position: one-arm push-up position with feet together, free hand on the lower back and a basketball under the hips.
PSH-08.altEnd: Half one-arm push-up, end position: lowered on the working arm until the hips touch the basketball, body square and straight.

start: Working hand on the floor under the chest
Other arm straight out to the side, palm on a basketball
end: Bend only the working arm; the ball arm stays straight
Lower until the chest is a fist from the floor
Press up; swap sides
PSH-09.altStart: Lever push-up, start position: push-up position with one hand on the floor and the other arm straight out to the side with the palm on a basketball.
PSH-09.altEnd: Lever push-up, end position: chest lowered close to the floor on the bent working arm, the other arm still straight on the basketball.

start: One hand under the chest, arm straight
Free hand on the small of the back
end: Lower until the chest is a fist from the floor
Body square, no twist
Press back to a locked arm; swap sides
PSH-10.altStart: One-arm push-up, start position: one-arm push-up position, feet together, free hand on the lower back, working arm straight.
PSH-10.altEnd: One-arm push-up, end position: chest lowered to about a fist above the floor on one bent arm, body straight and square.

start: Upper back, shoulders and head on the floor
Hips stacked over shoulders, hands brace the lower back
Legs straight, together and vertical, toes pointed
end: Bend hips and knees together
Knees come down toward the forehead, heels toward the glutes
Shoulders stay down; straighten back to vertical
SQT-01.altStart: Shoulderstand squat, start position: lying on the upper back with hips stacked over the shoulders, hands bracing the lower back and straight legs pointing at the ceiling.
SQT-01.altEnd: Shoulderstand squat, end position: hips and knees bent so the knees come down toward the forehead, heels near the glutes, shoulders still on the floor.

start: Hinge into a table: torso about parallel to the floor
Hands on a knee-high support, weight shared
end: Bend knees and hips until hamstrings touch calves
Heels flat, keep pressure through the hands
Push back up through legs and hands
SQT-02.altStart: Jackknife squat, start position: standing with straight legs, hinged at the hips so the torso is level with the floor, hands on a knee-high support.
SQT-02.altEnd: Jackknife squat, end position: squatting down until the hamstrings rest on the calves, heels flat, torso leaning forward and hands still on the support.

start: Hands rest on a sturdy hip-high support
end: Squat to full depth, hamstrings on calves
Torso fairly upright, heels flat, knees over toes
Hands help only out of the bottom third
SQT-03.altStart: Supported squat, start position: standing tall with feet shoulder-width apart and hands resting on a hip-high support in front.
SQT-03.altEnd: Supported squat, end position: squatting all the way down, hamstrings on calves, heels flat, hands resting on a hip-high support.

start: Arms straight out at shoulder height
end: Hips back and down until knees reach about 90°
Heels flat, knees track the toes
Torso leans forward in line with the shins
SQT-04.altStart: Half squat, start position: standing tall with feet shoulder-width apart and arms held straight out in front at shoulder height.
SQT-04.altEnd: Half squat, end position: hips back and down until the knees are bent to about 90 degrees, thighs above parallel, heels flat and arms forward.

end: Full depth: hamstrings rest on calves, hips below knees
Heels flat, chest up, back flat
Drive up through the whole foot
SQT-05.altStart: Full squat, start position: standing tall with feet shoulder-width apart and arms held straight out in front.
SQT-05.altEnd: Full squat, end position: squatting all the way down with hamstrings on calves and hips below the knees, heels flat, chest up and arms forward.

start: Feet together, heels and toes touching
end: Full depth with feet still together
Knees travel further forward, slight extra lean
Heels stay down
SQT-06.altStart: Close squat, start position: standing tall with feet together, heels and toes touching, and arms held straight out in front.
SQT-06.altEnd: Close squat, end position: squatting all the way down with feet still together, knees well forward, heels flat and arms forward.

start: Working foot flat on the floor
Other foot rests on a ball in front, knee soft
end: Working leg squats to full depth, heel flat
Ball rolls forward; that leg gives light support only
Swap legs
SQT-07.altStart: Uneven squat, start position: standing on the working leg with the other foot resting on top of a ball placed in front.
SQT-07.altEnd: Uneven squat, end position: the working leg squatted to full depth with the heel flat while the other leg stretches forward on the rolling ball.

start: Free leg straight, held forward just off the floor
end: Working knee bends to about 90°, heel flat
Knee tracks the toes
Free leg stays straight; lean forward to balance
SQT-08.altStart: Half one-leg squat, start position: balancing on one leg with the other leg straight and held forward just off the floor, arms forward.
SQT-08.altEnd: Half one-leg squat, end position: the working knee bent to about 90 degrees with the heel flat, the free leg straight and off the floor.

start: Balance on the working leg, free leg forward
One hand lightly grips a sturdy upright beside you
end: Full one-leg depth, hamstring on calf, heel flat
Free leg straight and level with the floor
Hand slides down; help only out of the bottom
SQT-09.altStart: Assisted one-leg squat, start position: balancing on one leg with the free leg forward and one hand lightly gripping an upright beside the body.
SQT-09.altEnd: Assisted one-leg squat, end position: one-leg squat at full depth with the free leg straight and level, the hand low on the upright for light help.

start: Free leg straight forward, off the floor
end: Rock bottom: hamstring on calf, free leg level
Heel, big toe and little toe stay planted
No hands; pause, then stand
SQT-10.altStart: One-leg squat (pistol), start position: balancing on one leg with the free leg straight out in front off the floor and arms extended forward.
SQT-10.altEnd: One-leg squat (pistol), end position: rock-bottom one-leg squat with the hamstring on the calf, the free leg straight and parallel to the floor, arms forward.

start: Feet close to the base of a sturdy upright
Grip it at chest height and lean back
end: Pull the chest in to the upright
Squeeze the shoulder blades together
Lower back to straight arms
PLL-01.altStart: Vertical pull, start position: standing close to a sturdy upright, gripping it at chest height and leaning back on straight arms.
PLL-01.altEnd: Vertical pull, end position: pulled in until the chest is next to the upright, elbows bent back.

start: Lie under a hip-high bar or table edge
Heels on the floor, body straight
end: Pull the chest up to the bar
Body stays rigid from heels to head
Lower under control
PLL-02.altStart: Horizontal pull, start position: lying face up under a hip-high bar, holding it with straight arms, heels on the floor and body straight.
PLL-02.altEnd: Horizontal pull, end position: chest pulled up to the bar with elbows bent, body still straight and heels on the floor.

start: Hips under a chest-high bar, arms straight
Legs straight out, heels on a support in front
end: Pull until the chin clears the bar
Push lightly through the heels to help
Lower to straight arms
PLL-03.altStart: Jackknife pull, start position: hanging from a bar with straight arms, legs out in front and heels resting on a support, body in an L shape.
PLL-03.altEnd: Jackknife pull, end position: chin pulled over the bar, elbows bent, heels still on the support.

start: Hang from the bar, elbows bent about 90°
end: Pull until the chin is over the bar
No kipping or swinging
Lower back to 90° only
PLL-04.altStart: Half pull-up, start position: hanging from an overhead bar with elbows bent about 90 degrees and the head below the bar.
PLL-04.altEnd: Half pull-up, end position: chin pulled over the bar with elbows fully bent.

end: Pull until the chin is over the bar
Elbows drive down and back
Lower all the way to straight arms
PLL-05.altStart: Full pull-up, start position: dead hang from an overhead bar with straight arms and hands shoulder-width.
PLL-05.altEnd: Full pull-up, end position: chin pulled over the bar with elbows bent and pulled down.

start: Dead hang with the hands touching
end: Pull until the chin is over the bar
Keep the hands together
Lower to straight arms
PLL-06.altStart: Close pull-up, start position: dead hang from an overhead bar with straight arms and hands touching.
PLL-06.altEnd: Close pull-up, end position: chin pulled over the bar with the hands still together.

start: One hand on the bar, close grip
Other hand clasps the working wrist
end: Pull until the chin is over the bar
The bar arm does the work; the wrist hand only helps
Lower; swap sides each set
PLL-07.altStart: Uneven pull-up, start position: dead hang with one hand on the bar and the other hand clasping that wrist.
PLL-07.altEnd: Uneven pull-up, end position: chin pulled over the bar, the free hand still clasping the working wrist.

start: Hang from one arm, elbow bent about 90°
Free arm relaxed at the side
end: Pull until the chin is over the bar
Don't twist or kick
Lower to 90° only; swap arms
PLL-08.altStart: Half one-arm pull-up, start position: hanging from one hand with the elbow bent about 90 degrees, the free arm at the side.
PLL-08.altEnd: Half one-arm pull-up, end position: chin pulled over the bar on one arm.

start: One hand on the bar, arm straight
Other hand on a towel lower down
end: Pull hard with the bar arm, helped by the towel
Let go of the towel halfway up
Finish chin over the bar on one arm
PLL-09.altStart: Assisted one-arm pull-up, start position: dead hang with one hand on the bar and the other gripping a towel lower down.
PLL-09.altEnd: Assisted one-arm pull-up, end position: chin over the bar on one arm, the towel hand released.

end: Pull until the chin is over the bar
Stay square to the bar
Lower all the way; swap arms
PLL-10.altStart: One-arm pull-up, start position: dead hang from an overhead bar on one straight arm.
PLL-10.altEnd: One-arm pull-up, end position: chin pulled over the bar on one bent arm.

start: Sit on the edge of a bench, hands gripping beside the hips
Legs straight, feet a few inches off the floor
end: Draw the knees up to the chest
Exhale as the knees come in
Extend the legs back out without touching the floor
LGR-01.altStart: Knee tuck, start position: sitting on the edge of a bench, leaning back with hands on the edge and straight legs held just off the floor.
LGR-01.altEnd: Knee tuck, end position: knees drawn up toward the chest, feet off the floor, still leaning back slightly.

start: Lie on the back, hands by the hips
Knees bent 90°, heels just off the floor
end: Raise the knees until the thighs are vertical
Keep the knee angle fixed
Lower until the heels nearly touch
LGR-02.altStart: Flat knee raise, start position: lying face up with knees bent at a right angle and heels just off the floor.
LGR-02.altEnd: Flat knee raise, end position: thighs raised to vertical with knees still bent 90 degrees, lower back on the floor.

start: Lie on the back, hands by the hips
end: Raise the legs until the thighs are vertical
Keep the knees at the same bend
Lower slowly, feet off the floor
LGR-03.altStart: Flat bent-leg raise, start position: lying face up with legs slightly bent and the feet held just off the floor.
LGR-03.altEnd: Flat bent-leg raise, end position: thighs raised to vertical with the knees still slightly bent.

start: Lie on the back, knees bent and drawn in
end: Raise the knees, then straighten the legs to vertical
Lower with straight legs
Bend again near the bottom
LGR-04.altStart: Flat frog raise, start position: lying face up with knees bent and heels just off the floor.
LGR-04.altEnd: Flat frog raise, end position: legs straightened and pointing straight up, lower back on the floor.

start: Lie on the back, hands by the hips
Legs straight, heels a couple of inches up
end: Raise straight legs to vertical
No arching the lower back
Lower slowly; don't rest the heels
LGR-05.altStart: Flat straight-leg raise, start position: lying face up with straight legs held a couple of inches off the floor.
LGR-05.altEnd: Flat straight-leg raise, end position: straight legs raised to point at the ceiling, lower back flat.

end: Raise the knees to chest height
Tilt the pelvis up at the top
Lower to a dead hang without swinging
LGR-06.altStart: Hanging knee raise, start position: dead hang from an overhead bar with straight legs.
LGR-06.altEnd: Hanging knee raise, end position: hanging with knees raised to chest height and bent.

end: Keep the knee bend fixed and raise the legs
Stop when the feet reach hip height
Lower under control
LGR-07.altStart: Hanging bent-leg raise, start position: dead hang from an overhead bar with the knees bent about 45 degrees.
LGR-07.altEnd: Hanging bent-leg raise, end position: hanging with the legs raised until the feet are at hip height, knees still bent about 45 degrees.

start: Hang with the knees bent, feet below the hips
end: Raise the knees, then straighten the legs level with the floor
Lower with straight legs
Bend the knees again at the bottom
LGR-08.altStart: Hanging frog raise, start position: hanging from a bar with the knees bent and the feet below the hips.
LGR-08.altEnd: Hanging frog raise, end position: hanging with straight legs held out level with the floor.

end: Raise straight legs halfway, about 45°
Pause, no momentum
Lower to a dead hang
LGR-09.altStart: Partial hanging straight-leg raise, start position: dead hang from an overhead bar with straight legs together.
LGR-09.altEnd: Partial hanging straight-leg raise, end position: hanging with straight legs raised halfway, about 45 degrees.

end: Raise straight legs until level with the floor
Body forms an L; pause
Lower slowly without swinging
LGR-10.altStart: Hanging straight-leg raise, start position: dead hang from an overhead bar with straight legs together.
LGR-10.altEnd: Hanging straight-leg raise, end position: hanging in an L with straight legs held level with the floor.

start: Lie on the back, knees bent, feet flat
Arms by the sides, palms down
end: Push through the heels to lift the hips
Stop at a straight line from shoulders to knees
Shoulders stay on the floor
BRG-01.altStart: Short bridge, start position: lying face up with knees bent, feet flat near the hips and arms by the sides.
BRG-01.altEnd: Short bridge, end position: hips lifted so the shoulders, hips and knees form a straight line, shoulders on the floor.

start: Hands on the floor beside the hips, fingers toward the feet
end: Drive the hips up until the body is straight
Arms straight, head relaxed back
Lower back to sitting
BRG-02.altStart: Straight bridge, start position: sitting with straight legs out in front and hands on the floor beside the hips.
BRG-02.altEnd: Straight bridge, end position: hips pushed up into a straight line from heels to shoulders on straight arms, head tilted back.

start: Upper back on a knee-high bench
Hands beside the head on the bench, fingers toward the feet
end: Press through palms and heels
Lift shoulders and hips into an angled bridge
Lower the upper back to the bench
BRG-03.altStart: Angled bridge, start position: upper back resting on a knee-high bench, hands beside the head on it, knees bent and feet on the floor.
BRG-03.altEnd: Angled bridge, end position: pressed up on straight arms from the bench into an angled bridge, hips raised.

start: Full bridge, arms and legs pushing
Hands beside the head, fingers toward the feet
end: Lower until the top of the head lightly touches
Keep the hips up
Press back to straight arms
BRG-04.altStart: Head bridge, start position: full bridge on straight arms with the hips high.
BRG-04.altEnd: Head bridge, end position: bridge lowered until the top of the head touches the floor, elbows bent, hips still raised.

start: Hands beside the head on the floor
end: Press up into a bridge over the ball
Straighten the arms, lift the hips
Lower back onto the ball
BRG-05.altStart: Half bridge, start position: lying back over a basketball with hands beside the head and feet flat on the floor.
BRG-05.altEnd: Half bridge, end position: pressed up into a bridge on straight arms above the basketball.

start: Lie on the back, knees bent, feet flat
Palms beside the head, fingers toward the feet
end: Press up until the arms are straight
Hips are the highest point
Lower under control
BRG-06.altStart: Full bridge, start position: lying face up with knees bent and palms on the floor beside the head.
BRG-06.altEnd: Full bridge, end position: full bridge with straight arms, hips high and the back arched.

start: Stand two to three feet from a wall, back to it
Arch back and place the palms on the wall
end: Walk the hands down the wall
Finish in a full bridge on the floor
Look for the floor as you go
BRG-07.altStart: Wall-walk bridge (down), start position: standing with the back to a wall, arched backward with the palms on the wall overhead.
BRG-07.altEnd: Wall-walk bridge (down), end position: full bridge on the floor near the wall after walking the hands down it.

start: Full bridge, hands near the base of the wall
end: Walk the hands up the wall
Push the hips forward as you rise
Finish standing
BRG-08.altStart: Wall-walk bridge (up), start position: full bridge on the floor with the hands near the base of a wall.
BRG-08.altEnd: Wall-walk bridge (up), end position: standing with the back to the wall after walking the hands up it, still lightly arched.

end: Arch back and lower under control
Hands land beside the head
Finish in a full bridge
BRG-09.altStart: Closing bridge, start position: standing with arms overhead, hips forward and the upper back arching backward.
BRG-09.altEnd: Closing bridge, end position: full bridge on the floor after arching back from standing.

end: Arch back into a full bridge: the bottom of the rep
Rock the weight toward the feet
Push back up to standing
BRG-10.altStart: Stand-to-stand bridge, start position: standing with arms overhead and hips forward, ready to arch back.
BRG-10.altEnd: Stand-to-stand bridge, end position: full bridge on the floor, the bottom of a stand-to-stand rep before pushing back up to standing.

start: Head and hands on the floor in a triangle near a wall
Hips over the head, knees bent
Weight on the hands as well as the head
end: Lift the legs up the wall
Heels rest on the wall, legs straight
Hold, breathing steadily
HSP-01.altStart: Wall headstand, start position: head and hands on the floor in a triangle near a wall, hips raised over the head, feet still on the floor.
HSP-01.altEnd: Wall headstand, end position: headstand against the wall with straight legs and heels resting on it.

start: Squat with hands flat on the floor
Knees resting on the backs of the upper arms
end: Lean forward until the feet leave the floor
Balance on the hands
Hold, then step back down
HSP-02.altStart: Crow stand, start position: deep squat with hands flat on the floor and knees resting on the bent upper arms.
HSP-02.altEnd: Crow stand, end position: balancing on the hands with knees on the upper arms and feet off the floor.

start: Hands on the floor a short way from a wall
Hips high, one leg ready to kick
end: Kick up to a handstand
Heels rest on the wall, arms locked
Hold, then come down one leg at a time
HSP-03.altStart: Wall handstand, start position: bent over with hands on the floor near a wall, one leg ready to kick up.
HSP-03.altEnd: Wall handstand, end position: handstand against the wall with arms locked and heels on the wall.

end: Lower halfway, elbows about 90°
Head stays clear of the floor
Press back to locked arms
HSP-04.altStart: Half handstand push-up, start position: wall handstand with arms locked and heels on the wall.
HSP-04.altEnd: Half handstand push-up, end position: lowered halfway with elbows bent about 90 degrees, still upside down against the wall.

end: Lower until the top of the head lightly touches
Head and hands form a triangle
Press back to locked arms
HSP-05.altStart: Handstand push-up, start position: wall handstand with arms locked.
HSP-05.altEnd: Handstand push-up, end position: lowered until the top of the head lightly touches the floor, elbows bent.

start: Wall handstand with the hands touching
end: Lower until the head lightly touches
Elbows track forward
Press back up
HSP-06.altStart: Close handstand push-up, start position: wall handstand with arms locked and hands touching.
HSP-06.altEnd: Close handstand push-up, end position: lowered until the head touches the floor, hands still together.

start: Wall handstand, one hand on a basketball
Other hand flat on the floor
end: Lower until the head nears the floor
Floor arm does most of the work
Press up; swap sides
HSP-07.altStart: Uneven handstand push-up, start position: wall handstand with one hand on the floor and the other on a basketball.
HSP-07.altEnd: Uneven handstand push-up, end position: lowered toward the floor with both elbows bent, one hand still on the basketball.

end: Lower halfway on one arm
Stay square to the wall
Press back up; swap arms
HSP-08.altStart: Half one-arm handstand push-up, start position: one-arm handstand against the wall with the working arm locked.
HSP-08.altEnd: Half one-arm handstand push-up, end position: lowered halfway on one bent arm, heels still on the wall.

start: Wall handstand, working hand under the shoulder
Other arm straight out to the side on a basketball
end: Bend the working arm only
Lower until the head nears the floor
Press up; swap sides
HSP-09.altStart: Lever handstand push-up, start position: wall handstand with one hand on the floor and the other arm straight out to the side on a basketball.
HSP-09.altEnd: Lever handstand push-up, end position: lowered on the bent working arm, the other arm still straight on the basketball.

start: Wall handstand on one locked arm
end: Lower until the head lightly touches
Keep the body square
Press back to a locked arm; swap
HSP-10.altStart: One-arm handstand push-up, start position: one-arm handstand against the wall with the working arm locked.
HSP-10.altEnd: One-arm handstand push-up, end position: lowered on one bent arm until the head nears the floor, heels on the wall.
